$description: Fresh Orbit illustration slots (D53). Every image the apps show fills one slot. Edit scene, alt, characters or style here, then run `pnpm --filter @fresh/illustrations prompts` to rebuild the prompts and `pnpm --filter @fresh/illustrations validate`. To use a final image: save assets/<name>.webp, set file to it and status to FINAL. See README.md.

FISHMONGER.description: A cheerful woman in her early forties from coastal Andhra Pradesh with warm brown skin, a round face with laugh lines and bright dark eyes; dark hair in a low bun wrapped with a small string of white jasmine flowers; a small red dot bindi and small gold stud earrings; wears a teal cotton saree with a thin coral border, sleeves rolled to the elbow, under a sand-coloured canvas apron with one front pocket; her props are a woven bamboo basket and a small stainless steel hanging scale; same face, hair and clothes in every picture

RIDER.description: A confident young woman in her mid twenties with deep brown skin and a wide friendly smile; long black hair in a single side braid that shows below her helmet; wears a rounded teal scooter helmet with one coral stripe, a teal zip jacket with silver reflective bands over a sand t-shirt, dark grey cargo trousers and sturdy shoes; her props are a chunky insulated cold box in white and teal with a frosty lid and a small rounded teal scooter; same face, hair and clothes in every picture

SUPPORT_AGENT.description: A kind man in his thirties with medium brown skin, short neat wavy black hair and a trimmed full beard, gentle eyes and a warm smile; wears a coral half-sleeve collared shirt and a teal over-ear headset with a small microphone; his prop is a slim tablet; same face, hair and clothes in every picture

HOME_COOK.description: A warm grandfather in his sixties with light brown skin, rounded cheeks, short silver hair and a thick silver moustache; wears a cream half-sleeve shirt with a fine teal check and a white veshti with a coral border, with a striped kitchen towel over one shoulder; his props are a round clay cooking pot and a steel ladle; same face, hair and clothes in every picture

POMFRET.description: A small round silver pomfret fish about the size of a hand, glossy pearl-silver body with a faint teal sheen on the fins, large friendly dark eyes, rosy coral cheeks and tiny fins it uses like hands; it floats in the air beside the others and is always cute, never food; same look in every picture
